statement: We believe in zero waste philosophy (as in Mother Nature there is no waste). Zero waste includes Zero solid waste (recycling 100%) and Zero liquid waste (recycle liquid discharge by STP).
Company have ONGC gas connection which contributes in green energy and enviroment friendly.
In addition, all new projects undergo a comprehensive environmental impact assessment, with carbon-adjusted Internal Rate of Return (IRR) being a critical consideration in capital allocation.
Plantation activities under Swachh Bharat Abhiyan in Anand, Gujarat.

The company has been granted a Patent as at 2nd June, 2022 & 22nd Dec, 2023 related to 'Process for Recovery of Gypsum from Stainless Steel ETP Neutralized sludge' & 'Process for Recovery of Metals from Stainless Steel ETP Neturalized Sludge' respectively, which addresses the management of industrial waste and pollution.
